Pi coding-agent core
|
|-- AgentSessionRuntime (CLI runtime owner)
|   |-- current AgentSession
|   |   |-- API: prompt / steer / followUp / abort / compact / navigateTree
|   |   |-- Run orchestration and recovery
|   |   |   `-- -> held Agent.prompt()/continue(); settle beyond agent_end
|   |   |-- Agent (held execution engine)
|   |   |   |-- _state: messages, model, thinking, tools, streaming state
|   |   |   |-- steeringQueue / followUpQueue; activeRun abort controller
|   |   |   `-- prompt()/continue() -> agent-loop.ts functions
|   |   |-- SessionManager (held canonical history manager)
|   |   |   `-- Owns entry tree and selected leaf, not Agent's live state
|   |   |-- Tool registry + definitions + ExtensionRunner
|   |   |   `-- -> ResourceLoader extensions; -> Agent callable tools
|   |   |-- Run flags, pending messages and public event listeners
|   |   |   `-- Agent events -> extension handlers -> subscribers -> persistence
|   |   |-- Recovery controllers: compaction, summaries, retry; bash controllers
|   |   |-- CacheWarmer handle
|   |   `-- Service references -> settings, resources and model runtime below
|   |-- AgentSessionServices (cwd-bound infrastructure bundle)
|   |   |-- SettingsManager
|   |   |-- ResourceLoader
|   |   `-- ModelRuntime
|   `-- Replacement: newSession / switchSession / fork
|       |-- await session.abort(): settle outgoing results before replacement
|       |-- -> session_shutdown hooks -> host UI invalidation callback
|       |-- session.dispose(): invalidate extension contexts; detach listeners
|       |   `-- Abort remaining work including bash; cancel warmer; clean resources
|       `-- -> factory -> apply new session/services -> rebindSession callback
|
|-- CLI hosts: InteractiveMode / runPrintMode / runRpcMode
|   `-- -> AgentSessionRuntime; use its current session API
`-- SDK factory: createAgentSession() (runtime wrapper not required)
    |-- Creates or accepts history manager, settings, model runtime and resources
    |-- Restored branch + settings + explicit options -> initial selection/tools
    `-- Constructs Agent -> AgentSession; returns session to caller
